# TIDE Peptide Laboratory

> Guangzhou-based peptide manufacturing partner for international B2B research customers. 72,000 m2 of dedicated research, development and production space. Every batch is documented with a Freedom Diagnostics certificate of analysis stating tested purity, lot number and report date.

## Company
- Brand: TIDE Peptide Laboratory (TIDE)
- Location: Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- Facility: 72,000 m2 of dedicated peptide research, development and production space
- Scope: peptide synthesis, purification, analytical testing, batch documentation, OEM/ODM coordination
- Customers: overseas B2B buyers, research suppliers and distributors

## Quality documentation
- 36 current Freedom Diagnostics (United States) certificates of analysis, reported 17-22 September 2026
- Tested purity range across the current batch set: 99.01% - 99.98%
- Each certificate records: product name, accession number, lot number, received and reported dates, HPLC-UV purity, LC-MS identity, net content, chromatogram and mass confirmation
- Full archive: [COA Reports](https://tide-peptide.com/coa/)

## Products
- 60+ peptide models, each listed with its formal product name and the SKU code used in the price list
- Categories include metabolic and weight-management peptides, growth hormone secretagogues, repair and recovery peptides, neuro and sleep peptides, and laboratory solvents
- Example SKU codes: SM5 / SM10 (Semaglutide), TR10 / TR20 (Tirzepatide), RT10 / RT20 (Retatrutide), BC5 / BC10 (BPC-157), TB5 / TB10 (TB-500), TSM5 / TSM10 (Tesamorelin)
- Full archive: [Products](https://tide-peptide.com/products/)
